notes.title: Update Notice (09/10/2025)
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for your continued support of “PLATiNA :: LAB”.[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to inform you about the upcoming update scheduled for [b]Wednesday, September 10.[/b][/p][p]This update will be carried out without server downtime, and you will be able to continue enjoying the game normally by installing the latest client version released on that day.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]New Contents[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546797/dc5bca7dce4a461eba968ecc8a37c2a06682fc30.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The following new songs will be added:[/p][list][*][p]Standard Songs[/p][list][*][p]“[b]Innocent[/b]” by 削除 VS まらしぃ[/p][/*][*][p]“[b]BULK UP[/b]” by USAO & Yuta Imai[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]You can now enter \[Enter Promotion Code] in Settings > ACCOUNT. Enter codes received from events or promotions here to claim in-game rewards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Adjustments and improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Improved the skip feature for result screen animations.[/p][list][*][p]The score tally animation can now be skipped earlier.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to skip the [b]“P.A.T.C.H. Point Increase”[/b] animation.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The \[Note Layout] options have been partially updated as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Renamed: \[HALF MIRROR] → [b]\[TWIST][/b][/p][list][*][p]Split the note lanes into left and right groups, and flip each group horizontally.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Option: [b]\[M-HALF RANDOM][/b][/p][list][*][p]Layouts adjusted by \[HALF RANDOM] are now mirrored horizontally.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where using \[HALF MIRROR] displayed the same note layout as \[MIRROR].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where BPM information was not displayed correctly on the waiting screen after song selection for songs with speed changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where character animations on the results screen were not smooth when selecting \[Label (Diving)] [i]DB[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p]

We sincerely appreciate your continued support for “PLATiNA :: LAB”.[/p]

notes.title: Apology for the Delay in the Release of the “AQUA BLUE” DLC
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is HIGH-END Games.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely apologize to all our users for the sudden delay in the release of the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack, which was originally scheduled for release on Friday, August 22, and deeply regret that we were unable to provide sufficient guidance and communication during the process of deciding to postpone, causing disappointment to those who have been eagerly awaiting the DLC.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Currently, the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack has experienced significant delays due to multiple requests for revisions to the product introduction images during the pre-release content review process on the Steam platform.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]As soon as the Steam review process is completed, we will promptly release the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]In addition, as an apology for the delay, we will provide the free song [i]"Core"[/i] in the update applied on the same day.[/p][p][/p][p]We fully recognize that a “release schedule” represents more than just a date — it is an important promise we make to our users, and we  deeply regret failing to keep that promise and the trust you placed in us, and we humbly apologize.[/p][p][/p][p]We believe that the primary cause of the delay in the release of the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack was our insufficient preparation, as we failed to fully account for the time and variables required for platform-specific review processes within the DLC development schedule.[/p][p][/p][p]We will take this experience as an opportunity to thoroughly improve our internal processes for content development and release preparation, and we will also ensure that, in cases where adjusting a release schedule is unavoidable, we will ensure that the reasons and follow-up measures are shared promptly and transparently.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, we sincerely apologize to all our users.[/p][p][/p][p]HIGH-END Games[/p]

notes.title: Notice of Service Resumption and Delay in DLC Release
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is HIGH-END Games.[/p][p]Most of the internal issues for the release have been resolved, but since there are still some remaining issues, DLC-related content will be put on hold while we resume the main service.[/p][p]Our team is doing everything we can to deliver the AQUA BLUE DLC content as soon as possible.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the unavoidable delay in the DLC release schedule, and we will provide an update through an official notice once the new release date has been determined. [/p]

notes.title: Notice of Delay in Release of “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is HIGH-END Games.

First of all, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the players who have been waiting for the release of PLATiNA :: LAB – AQUA BLUE DLC PACK.

During our internal testing, we identified some in-game issues that require additional work to resolve. As a result, the DLC release will be delayed from the originally planned schedule.

We will provide an update immediately once the new release schedule has been confirmed.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to everyone who has been waiting.

For those who purchased the DLC through the funding campaign, the code will be delivered to the email address registered with Tumblbug.
If you have not received your code, please contact us via Tumblbug DM and we will promptly resend it to you.[/p][p]
[url="https://tumblbug.com/platinalab" style="button"]Go to Tumblbug Project Page[/url][/p]

notes.title: Current Known Issues and Improvement Plans (2025-05-14)
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of "PLATiNA :: LAB".

We would like to provide a brief overview of the major technical issues currently identified in the game as of May 14, 2025. Additionally, we would like to share our upcoming plans to address and improve these issues.



[h2]Current Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Certain keys (e.g., the [+] key on the NumPad) not registering correctly in specific environments.
[*] Key inputs occasionally not being recognized during gameplay.
[*] CPU and memory usage increase abnormally during gameplay.
[*] The 'Audio Buffer Size' option in Settings is not applying correctly and remaining fixed at a specific value.
[*] The game becomes unplayable or fails to launch when configuration files are corrupted or contain invalid values.
[*] Flickering or ghosting appears in the letterbox area when running the game in fullscreen mode with certain aspect ratios.
[*] System resource usage spiking abnormally while on the song selection screen.
[/list]
We are also actively investigating a number of additional issues that have been reported by many of the DECODERs.



[h2]Improvement Plan[/h2]
Many of the issues listed above have been confirmed to significantly impact the gameplay experience, and we understand that they have caused considerable inconvenience to a large number of DECODERs.

In light of this, [b]we will prioritize patch updates focused on bug fixes and feature improvements throughout the month of May.[/b] This will be done ahead of the upcoming content update and the launch of our first DLC, to ensure that DECODERs do not experience further disruption due to these issues.

The key changes scheduled to be implemented during this period are as follows:


[h3]Redesign of the Input System and Additional Configuration Options[/h3]
The internal input handling system is being redesigned for greater optimization and broader compatibility. This update aims to fundamentally resolve existing issues where certain keys (such as NumPad keys or the [Alt] key) were not functioning correctly, and where key inputs were not recognized on keyboards with non-standard layouts such as AZERTY.

Additionally, the polling rate for key input events will be updated to support 1000Hz and 8000Hz frequencies. An additional option will also be introduced in the Settings menu, allowing DECODERs to manually adjust the input polling rate according to their preferences.

To further accommodate varying hardware environments, a new option will be added to the Settings menu, allowing DECODERs to choose between two distinct input processing modes in case issues persist after the update:
[list]
[*] [b]Performance-Oriented Mode[/b]: Prioritizes responsiveness and input speed.
[*] [b]Compatibility-Oriented Mode[/b]: Prioritizes stability and reliable operation across a wide range of input environments.[/list]

[h3]Optimization of CPU and Memory Usage During Gameplay[/h3]
While some DECODERs have been able to enjoy smooth gameplay on laptops with integrated graphics cards, we have also confirmed reports of performance issues—including stuttering and frame drops—even on systems equipped with high-performance dedicated GPUs.

Our investigation has determined that these issues stem not from insufficient GPU optimization, which has already been implemented, but rather from a lack of optimization in CPU and memory usage within the game.

To address this, we will be implementing broad optimizations across the game codebase to reduce CPU and memory usage. This is especially important as CPU load directly impacts the stability of input detection. Therefore, we expect this update to provide noticeable improvements for DECODERs who have experienced input delay or missed inputs due to performance degradation.


[h3]Redesign of the Audio System and Resolution of Configuration-Related Issues[/h3]
We are undertaking a comprehensive review and redesign of the system related to audio output devices. As part of this effort, improvements will be made to ensure that the game continues to operate smoothly even when unexpected or invalid values are loaded from the audio configuration settings.

With this update, issues such as being unable to launch the game due to incorrect configuration settings, or the "Audio Buffer Size" option not applying correctly, will be resolved. Additionally, DECODERs will be able to change the "Audio Buffer Size" setting regardless of the "Use ASIO Device" option's ON/OFF state.



In addition to the issues outlined in this notice, we will do our utmost to implement as many improvements as possible throughout the month of May. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused and would like to express our deepest gratitude to all DECODERs who continue to support and enjoy the game despite its current shortcomings.

We kindly ask for your continued interest and support in the upcoming new content and DLC updates scheduled for release after June.

[b]PLATiNA :: LAB Development Team[/b]

[list]

[list]

[*] The original design of the missions was to allow players to unlock content by progressing through the full tracklist of the game. However, this ultimately led to an excessive burden for completing individual missions, resulting in a negative gameplay experience. Therefore, we have improved the overall direction of the missions to allow for a more comfortable unlocking process compared to before. The unlocking experience is something we hold in high regard, and we will continue to make every effort to ensure that you have an enjoyable experience in the future.[/list][*] (P.A.T.C.H.) Fixed an issue where the UI would display incorrectly when switching to a LINES mode tab with no registered songs in the “P.A.T.C.H. Target Song Info.” screen.

This was done without affecting the intrinsic difficulty of the patterns or the fairness of ranking inclusion. Therefore, existing personal records for the affected patterns will not be reset.

We will handle such changes with utmost care to minimize the likelihood of similar cases occurring in the future. We sincerely ask for your understanding.[/list][*] Adjusted the judgment interval and related effects applied when holding long notes in certain patterns.
[/list]

We will continue to do our best to provide an even better gaming experience.
Thank you.

notes.title: 'PLATiNA :: LAB' is now available in EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546797/7de157935b2fe92aad28ba0aa73eaf62a873893e.png[/img]
On April 11, 2025, 'PLATiNA :: LAB' was released into Early Access.

In Early Access, you'll get early access to some of the core features and songs outlined in this announcement, and we'll continue to add more songs and content leading up to the general release. We hope you'll stay tuned.

[previewyoutube=58Enli8NNgQ;full][/previewyoutube]



[h2]Core features in Early Access[/h2]

[h3]Research Notes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546797/679a30165db30f01d531e12ad99071260b115b31.png[/img]
[list]
[*] You can unlock additional in-game content by completing various missions given to you in your Research Notes.
[*] The types of content unlocked will start with songs and DBs (characters), and will gradually expand in future updates.
[/list]

[h3]Character Voices[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546797/648866d9fedeca2d870fc0678d00bd6b3686bc1d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The six DBs you'll meet during Early Access are voiced by professional voice actors with distinctive personalities. Listen to the DBs as they come to life throughout the game.

[list]
[*] [b]AiRING[/b] (Voice: 권다예)
[*] [b]Bambi[/b] (Voice: 김순미)
[*] [b]Cake[/b] (Voice: 이이로)
[*] [b]Roro[/b] (Voice: 김채린)
[*] [b]Ena[/b] (Voice: 강새봄)
[*] [b]Label[/b] (Voice: 유혜지)
[/list]
[*] Additionally, when Story Mode is added with the Full Release, all of the main characters' dialog will be fully voiced.
[/list]

[h3]P.A.T.C.H.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546797/7dc437621239d838a31e8000aef95ec32b27a1c4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] P.A.T.C.H. (PLATiNA Aptitude Test & Calibration Hub) is a system that helps you understand your objective skill level by giving you a point and grade based on your performance on the top 50 patterns you've cleared.
[*] Bring out your best performers and challenge yourself to a higher grade, or rank high in the rankings within your tier!
[list]
[*] Currently, P.A.T.C.H. point rankings are available on the official website, and we'll be adding the feature to view them in-game in the near future.
[/list][/list]


[h2]Playable songs[/h2]

In Early Access, there are [b]a total of 73+ songs[/b] available to play, including both those that are immediately playable and those that must be unlocked through the Research Notes.

Check out the 'TRACK SHOWCASE' video uploaded to our official YouTube channel to see the playable songs.

[previewyoutube=1oaZTvx3sa0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=gGuIuPfTzO4;full][/previewyoutube]


An unpredictable world of data.
Start your first study with quirky 'DB's now.

[b]PLATiNA :: LAB[/b]
